text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(True! My roots might've been shallow. 
Even so—!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(I have never once wanted to lose. To find 
a way to win, I must—!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(...Reach, reach, reach, reach, reach! All 
the way to victory!!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "REAAAACH THEEEEEMMM!! DAAAAAAAAAAGHHH!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Royce and Royce! First place goes to 
Royce and Royce!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Having repelled countless powerhouses, she 
proudly seizes the Autumn Shield!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... Did... I do it? Did I 
win...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Going up against this lineup... in the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Royce-san, this is truly... a joyous 
occasion. If only the medicinal remedies I 
imparted proved even slightly helpful.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Chitose O-san... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To even surpass the "winning formula"... 
Not bad, Royce-kun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It's frustrating, but I can accept it. 
You, who shared joys and sorrows with me, 
are an Umamusume truly worthy of the 
Shield."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hayahide-san...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAHHH! I'm so frustrated~, but I'm so 
happyyy~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My feelings are all over the place, but... 
I'm so glad for you, Royce~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ticket-san... Yes... Yes...!

"With each word of congratulations, Royce 
and Royce's stiff expression began to 
soften."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Congrats, Royce-chan♪ Though Nature and I 
kinda want to run with more zip and zoom.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I don't consider this settled yet!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, Tannhauser-san... Yes, 
absolutely, in the near future!
And—at the Winner's Circle.
(WOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(He-hehehe... I am totally in the zone 
today! I feel like I can give the speech 
of a lifetime!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(A perfect chance for self-promotion! Say 
something clever and win their hearts.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Now then, what should I talk about? Which 
one from my repertoire should I pick...?)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Huh...? Words are coming out on their 
own...!? Not from my brain... but 
somewhere else...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(No, no, no...!! What in the world was I 
about to say...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I did itttt!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
How's thaaat, did you see that?! Who's 
ordinary now?! So what if I'm not a 
genius, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Look at me! Look at me more! Praise me, 
adore me...!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaaaahhhhh! If this is a dream, don't 
wake me uuup!!

Everyone... stood in stunned silence. A 
sudden breakdown of self-control.

The image she had crafted shattered into 
pieces, and raw emotion—exploded!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Royce...!? Did... did our Royce just break 
down?

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
B-But... there's something really touching 
about it... Royce-chan's always all about 
fan service, but—

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"You had bet that much on today's race, 
huh..."

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH, congratulaaations!!!!! I'm so 
happy for you! So happy!
(UOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Ha!?

The loudest cheer ever heardâ enveloped 
Royce and Royce.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah~~~, I messed up... I messed up big 
time...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
How could I make such a huge blunder?! 
Exposing such an unsightly, emotional 
mess... Why on earth did I...?!

If you were to ask "why?"... I felt there 
was only one answer.
choice_data_list: Because those are my true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh... True feelings? Mine...?

Self-producing to be loved. Even if I'm 
not the strongest, I want to be called 
"the strongest."

"In other words, I couldn't help but think 
they all stemmed from the exact same 
impulse."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In other words... what it comes down to 
is...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I want to be acknowledged by everyone. 
Commonly referred to as...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: A need for validation~?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my~

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no way~!!! After working so hard 
all this time to become my ideal self, 
too!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to stand out! Are you saying 
that's all I am to youuuu!???

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I thought she was a totally modern 
Umamusume, but to think she's this 
stubbornly self-centered...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm disappointed! Aren't we 
all?! You, me, the fans—everyone!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's right! There's no way anyone would 
still cheer for me...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"There's... no way. There's no way... 
right?"

I had a feeling that the actual scenery— 
wasn't quite like that.

A massive, fiery explosion of Royce and 
Royce's emotions. In response, the fans—

They cheered louder for me than ever 
before. That was undeniably—proof of their 
empathy.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You're saying you'll cheer for me...? Even 
someone like me...?

A turmoil within. And to make matters 
worse, as if to deal an additional blow to 
Royce and Royce...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...No way.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hayahide-san and... Ticket-san...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"They said both Hayahide and I need to 
rest for a while. Looks like fatigue built 
up in our legs!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aah, all of BNW have the day off, huh~ 
Maybe I'll go somewhere with Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I guess I'll never get to race 
against my sister. Leaving Royce-kun all 
by herself weighs on my mind too, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wish you luck. I'm glad I got to spend 
this once-in-a-lifetime season with you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You fools... the both of you. Because I 
am...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I was tricking you, okay? I just wanted 
to make myself look good. That's the only 
reason I sidled up to the three of you."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I just wanted to satisfy my 
desire for approval. And yet, Hayahide-san 
and the others still looked out for me 
even when things were toughest...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... I'm so sorry... Really... I'm 
sorry!

Royce and Royce apologized for how she had 
been acting up until now, but...
choice_data_list: It couldn't have been entirely a lie.
It couldn't have been entirely a lie.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Those tears... are real, aren't they?

text_block_list.text:
The Royce who desperately wants 
recognition. The Royce who regrets having 
deceived others. Both of them... are the 
real deal.

Of course, there is ego involved. Even 
so...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Pretentious, selfish, and yet unable to 
give up despite being totally ordinary... 
that's me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, even losing her friend 
from the turf...
choice_data_list:
That's a path Nice Nature has walked down 
too.

That's a path Nice Nature has walked down 
too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san... I see. With Teio-san going 
on break, you must feel the same way...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to feel this way... if I 
could help it. Staying superficial would 
have been so much easier. But—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I've come to know it. Myself, and sorrow. 
Now, I can—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I can express it even better. 
Express 'myself.'"
On Royce and Royce's face, at long last—
Life has—ignited.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I—want to run. I want to run 
again!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to acknowledge me through 
my own self-branding, not some fake image!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what is the next stage I should 
aim for?

In that case, the answer is clear. The 
place where the most eyes in Japanese 
racing gather. Namely—

A race that earns recognition from the 
whole world. And that race is right around 
the corner.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup... Tokyo... 2,400 meters...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The same stage as the Japanese Derby, 
where I once competed against BNW...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for the wonderful choice. And 
also, well—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Before running in the Japan Cup, there's 
someone I just have to talk to!
choice_data_list:
Someone I want to talk to? That would 
be...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now that I understand what kind of 
Umamusume I am, once again—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "I want to try facing it. —Facing 'her.'"
